claude.performance_metric: FY2022 net loss of $(50.6)M driven by ~$(86.6)M discontinued-operations loss; Grace Pacific/Materials & Construction segment classified held-for-sale (Dec 2022)
claude.rationale: The slice documents a strategic divestiture of the Materials & Construction segment (Grace Pacific and Maui quarry land) as part of a deliberate "simplify its business and allocate capital to commercial real estate" strategy, not any documented product/process misalignment—so p4_pathway is 0. Nothing in the slice describes an operations-versus-people/management/culture fracture or organizational integration breakdown over time, so p5_pathway is 0. The slice explicitly contains no information about how the transaction was structured at closing (archetype/business-model reconciliation), and the outcome record shows continuous reporting with a strategic REIT-focus divestiture rather than documented archetype or model incompatibility, so t1 and t2 are uncertain.
